captions.instagram:
Drivers: your miles may be your biggest write-off, but only the ones you can show.

✔️ The 2026 IRS business rate is 72.5 cents a mile from January to June and 76 cents from July to December.
✔️ 1,000 business miles in the second half of the year is $760 of mileage deduction.
✔️ Keep a log as you go: date, miles, where and why, plus your odometer at the start and end of the year.

Our Rideshare & Delivery Driver Tax Tracker logs each shift at the right rate for its date. The mileage calculator on our site does the quick math.
